existing_findings.classification: Existing 774 source-backed conceptual admission/correlation finding; not a new unique finding.
existing_findings.current_evidence: At 95e gpu/pauldron.rs 66–72 record validates its borrowed design, while 107–112 record_plates accepts a separate &PauldronDesign without validation or identity tie. At 163–192 it computes Permille::ONE.0 * u16::from(i+1) / u16::from(d.lower_lames); current design.rs 29–36 defines ONE as u16 1000. If lower_lames=255 and earlier fallible operations succeed, iteration i=65 computes 66000 above u16 maximum before division. Behavior depends on Rust overflow-check configuration; no product execution is claimed. valid_shape bounds lower lames to 3..7 and upper to 1..3, so this witness is outside the validated shape route.
existing_findings.actual_current_caller_limits: gpu/limb_build.rs:15–17,29–36 and adventuresim-character-creator/device_pauldron.rs:20–29,99–100 pass the same borrowed design to carrier formation and plate recording. No ordinary bad caller found in these bounded paths; public entry and raw buffer construction remain a separate admitted-surface question.
existing_findings.future_direction: Resolve F052 using a checked correlated design/carrier or explicit validation and identity enforcement at public admission; preserve fallible/pending device state and legitimate relative scales. Alias and implementation are centrally owned.

nonfindings: Extension terminal length is computed before bounds using u16-to-f32 conversion and multiplication; the entire raw u16 input range stays finite. The Rust integer-overflow premise does not apply to that expression.

With one lame, whole extension is intentionally terminal; terminal_share remains individually checked. With an admitted count 2..4, chart denominator lames−1 is positive. None means no extension chart.

Pauldron.valid_shape alone does not check fluting or gauge clearance, but enclosing LimbArmorDesign.validate separately calls pattern.validate and gauge.validate; their detailed predicates were not fully examined here.
The two traced current callers associate both operations with the same borrowed design. This does not prove arbitrary public consumers do so or that carrier/device completion succeeds.

Potential zero divisor in pauldron loops is not reached by those loops for zero count; admitted count range further protects normal path. Count 255 overflow in a separately submitted raw design is the existing F052, not an extra duplicate.
open_questions: Is record_plates intended as a public raw assembly entry, and where should the carrier and plate design identity be established or checked?
Are there other actual external callers or independently constructed DevicePauldronCarrier buffers, and what are their admitted contracts? Only two in-repository callers were read.
What exact shared gauge, chart kernel, native shape, fit, pending status and consumer validation guarantees apply? These remain unassessed.
What additional chart topology, readback identity, and other queue obligations apply? F050, F051 and F052 have distinct owner contracts; overlapping source is not automatic alias.
What do production behavior and visual result actually do? No runtime, shader execution, product validation or visual analysis was performed.

lenses.name: producer-propagation
lenses.assessment: Current LimbArmorDesign validates extension before the joint-cup shape route. Pauldron carrier record validates its own input; record_plates takes a separate design, and the two examined caller functions reuse the same borrowed design.

lenses.name: existing-type-owners
lenses.assessment: Millimeters, Milliradians, Permille and PlateGauge represent differing dimensions. Count fields remain raw u8 and need contextual admission; derived chart counts/ratios and armor component roles have separate meanings.

lenses.name: admission-contracts
lenses.assessment: JointExtension has a fallible validator; enclosing LimbArmorDesign checks optional fluting, cup construction, shape and shared gauge; Pauldron record uses this parent gate. Existing rig F052 records the separate public plate-recording admission gap.

lenses.name: invariant-operations
lenses.assessment: JointExtension terminal computation is f32 from u16 before its bounds and remains finite. Count=1 bypasses denominator; counts 2..4 have positive lames-1. Current unvalidated record_plates lower count can reach a u16 1000*(i+1) overflow if preceding operations succeed: existing F052, not a new count.

lenses.name: aggregate-states
lenses.assessment: Extension hem clearance depends on terminal length, count and share. Pauldron carrier/plate design identity is a relationship across independently supplied values; source examined public API does not carry explicit correlation evidence. Canonical callers inspected use the same design.

lenses.name: type-ownership
lenses.assessment: Authored design, admitted limb construction and pending device carrier each have separate roles. Proper owner of carrier/design association remains connected to F052; no independent generic wrapper required by the assessed facts.

lenses.name: redundant-authority
lenses.assessment: The carrier formed from one design and record_plates accepting a second design require correspondence, although ordinary callers reuse one borrowed source; no independent conflicting state was observed in those callers.

lenses.name: behavior-preservation
lenses.assessment: Historical assigned objects individually match 6533 and 95e; this does not prove equivalent external callers, device behavior, outcomes or a clean pr-working snapshot.

lenses.name: enum-shapes
lenses.assessment: Wrapped/RaisedCop are distinct construction modes. RaisedCop with extension is rejected by the inspected parent gate; optional extension and optional fluting remain legitimate. Single-lame extension deliberately uses full length.

lenses.name: derivability
lenses.assessment: Assigned structures derive ordinary Serde, Clone, equality and hashing. No manual trait or serializer implementation in assigned bodies requires a new finding.

lenses.name: type-granularity
lenses.assessment: A crown scale up to 1450 per mille is not automatically a probability; anatomical angles, millimetres, counts, course ids and native floating chart shares are distinct. Do not collapse them without unit and mode evidence.

lenses.name: magic-strings
lenses.assessment: No raw business string-valued API was found in the assigned source; displayed device support includes native shader text and resource labels, whose separate native requirements remain open.

lenses.name: magic-numbers
lenses.assessment: Observed extension length/count/share/hem limits, pauldron-specific thickness and lames limits, and chart ratio constants each encode contextual geometry/representation constraints. No arbitrary wrapper or untested visual acceptance inferred.
